Changelog

windscape (development version)

This release reorganizes windscape around a simpler workflow: download wind data or a pre-built wind rose, summarize the wind as a wind_rose, model connectivity with least-cost or random-walk functions that take the rose directly, and plot each step with ggplot2 layers.

Breaking changes

Wind data

  • cfsr_dl() and cfsr_dl_land() are replaced by download_wind_data() and download_land_mask(), which use NCAR’s Geoscience Data Exchange (see New features).
  • cfsr_usa and katrina datasets replaced by windscape_example().
  • wind_series() and wind_rose() now require lon/lat grids with (near-)square cells.
  • Selecting layers of a wind_series, wind_field, or wind_rose with [[ or subset(), or combining them with c(), now returns a plain SpatRaster, since the result no longer has the object’s structure. Use subset_series() to select time steps of a series.

Wind roses

  • as_wind_rose() and read_wind_rose() are merged into wind_rose(), which builds a rose from a wind_series, or loads a saved rose from an 8-layer raster or file path. rose() is no longer exported.
  • wind_rose() no longer takes ... (or cores); it gains filename and overwrite. trans must be a non-negative number or an elementwise function of wind speed.
  • wind_rose(): cells missing wind data at any time step are now NA in all eight layers, and calm time steps (zero wind speed) contribute no conductance whatever trans is (previously, with trans = 0, they counted toward one fixed direction).
  • terra::aggregate(), disagg(), resample(), and project() now signal an error on a wind_rose, since they would average conductances without accounting for cell size. Use downscale(), or change the grid of the wind_series before building the rose.

Least-cost model

  • least_cost_surface() is renamed least_cost(), and least_cost_distance() is renamed pairwise_least_cost(). Both take a wind_rose directly (a wind_graph built in advance is still accepted), and least_cost() gains a direction argument.
  • vrcd() is removed. pairwise_least_cost() now places sites at their actual locations within grid cells (snap = FALSE, the default), replacing both vrcd() and the adjust argument of least_cost_distance().
  • wind_graph(): wrap now defaults to NULL, which wraps global grids (spanning 360 degrees of longitude) automatically.

Random walk model

  • random_walk(): "ratchet" mode removed; results are now a named list of rasters; arguments reordered (general arguments before mode-specific ones). The new latitude correction (on by default) changes results on lon/lat grids.
  • random_walk() results are now per km^2 by default (density = TRUE).
  • particle_flow() is replaced by wind_trails(), which traces trails for a given transport time (hours) or length (distance).
  • tesselate() is removed; global grids now wrap automatically (see wrap arguments).

Requirements

  • windscape now requires R >= 4.0.0 and terra >= 1.8-42.

New features

Wind data

  • download_wind_data() downloads hourly wind from NCAR’s Geoscience Data Exchange, with no account needed: ERA5 (1940 to present; 10 m and 100 m), CFSR (1979-2010), and CFSv2 (2011 to present; 10 m and pressure levels). Data are clipped to a bounding box on the server, can be limited to particular days and hours (down to a single hour), and are saved as one file per month, with downloads cached so interrupted runs resume. Large requests are split to fit the server’s size limit.
  • download_land_mask() downloads a land-water layer on the same grid, e.g. for weight_conductance().
  • wind_series() combines file paths, rasters, or a list of series into one series that stays on disk.
  • subset_series() selects time steps by month, hour, date range, or index, and wind_times() returns the time of each step.
  • wind_field() gains step, to take one time step of a series as a field, and mean() of a wind_series gives its mean wind field.
  • windscape_example() loads small example data sets.

Wind roses

  • download_wind_rose() provides pre-built global wind roses (10 m CFSR, 1979-2010) for any combination of years and calendar months, optionally cropped to a region, which is read over the internet without downloading whole files. wind_rose_catalog() lists the available files and wind_rose_cache() manages downloaded ones.
  • wind_rose() is about five times faster, processes long series in chunks of time steps without loading them into memory, and records n_steps and trans in files written with filename, so they reload with wind_rose(file) alone.
  • combine_roses() combines roses built from different time periods, weighting them by their numbers of time steps.
  • net_flow() returns a rose’s net flow as a wind_field.

Least-cost model

  • least_cost_paths() traces fastest routes between sites and other points.

Random walk model

  • random_walk() gains mode = "stream" (steady state of continuous release, returning residence time and deposition), half_life (deposition), latitude_correction, direction = "upwind" (catchments), flux (net flux of material), source, and wrap.
  • pairwise_random_walk() computes random-walk connectivity among sets of sites.
  • random_walk_paths() traces flux streamlines between a source and where its material goes, the random-walk analog of least_cost_paths().
  • rw_exit_prob() gives each cell’s probability of mass leaving the domain.
  • rw_self_retention() for leave-one-out corrections of stream-mode results.

Plotting

  • ggplot2 layers for each object: geom_wind_arrow() and geom_wind_trail() for wind fields, geom_wind_rose() for wind roses, and geom_wind_path() for paths and trails, with scale_fill_bearing() and scale_colour_bearing() for direction-based colors, and fortify() methods for windscape objects.

Bug fixes

  • pairwise_least_cost() (formerly least_cost_distance(adjust = TRUE)) no longer returns NaN on the diagonal.
  • windscape no longer masks gdistance::geoCorrection().
  • Removed hidden dependencies on dplyr and magrittr being attached.

windscape 1.1.0

  • Initial release.
